panel.name: slipstream_contributors_panel
panel.text: Thank you to everyone who has contributed to Slipstream:
panel.text_editor: TheSlowly: Fly Override, camera pass-through option in Preferences, Preferences search focus, chat layout options (conversation sorting, typing in the conversation list, reorganised chat preferences), script dialog limits in Preferences, glTF model and material upload improvements

panel.name: tpv_credits_panel
panel.text: Slipstream includes code from other open source viewers, used under the LGPL 2.1:
panel.text_editor:
Firestorm Viewer (The Phoenix Firestorm Project, Inc. and contributors, including Ansariel Hiller and Techwolf Lupindo): area search, teleport history, LSL preprocessor, virtual trackpad, Photo Tools camera controls (Photo Studio's Cam section). The LSL preprocessor is Copyright (c) 2010 Modular Systems.
Alchemy Viewer (Rye Mutt and the Alchemy Development Group): the Lightbox, which Photo Studio grew from -- colour grading, Looks, scopes, lens and film effects and their undo history.
Black Dragon Viewer (NiranV Dean): camera tools, camera recording and playback, bone camera and head tracking, depth of field focus modes, right-click-drag orbit, snapshot window sizing.
